# Published Server databases

`server-v7-events.sql` is the `server-v7.sql` of [contrib-server-migrations](https://github.com/open-bazaar/contrib-server-migrations/tree/main/tests/fixtures), the database the original Server migration runner left after its seven published migrations, with the events a 0.2 node reported in it: a turn set off by a message, with a tool call, two usage totals and a reply, a turn that failed, the node's beat, and a new contact waiting to be let in.
